caption:
2 free hours in Shinjuku, Tokyo, before dinner? 🍁
See a garden first, then a free city view.

🥇 Shinjuku Gyoen garden (start early)
🍁 In autumn, the maples turn red.
🌳 Stay near the Shinjuku Gate end,
so you never have to rush out.

🥈 Free view from the Tokyo government building
🏙️ It's free and 202 m up.
🌅 Go near sunset, stay for the city lights.
⏱️ Allow about an hour, with the lift queue.
✨ After dark, a free light show
plays on the building's outside wall.

⏰ Winter tip
The garden closes early in the afternoon,
so do the garden first.

⛩️ Bonus: behind Golden Gai, red gates lead
to a quiet shrine where performers pray for luck.
💬 Comment GARDEN for our free Shinjuku evening plan,
including an izakaya alley tour to end the night.

📲 Send this to whoever you're having dinner with.
